paragraphs.source_en: Kaiser Industries was consistently lower than the net value of its parts. After Kaiser was split up, stockholders received $21 for shares that sold at $12. Sometimes companies think they are concentrating their communication efforts when they are really not. The positioning concept becomes so broad that it is almost meaningless. Which company calls itself "a developer and supplier of information systems for work, education and entertainment?" Would you believe Bell & Howell? That's right, Bell & Howell. The Monsanto Approach A good place to start a corporate positioning program is with a clear, concise definition of what a company is. But the best corporate positioning programs go beyond just a definition. The best programs do the job with actions, not just words. Or sometimes the words themselves represent the action.
